title: Game de Seishun
overview:
You can fall in love with and marry the person you like. You can take up the job you want. A board game with a new feel!!

Game de Seishun is a party board game about growing up. Enter your name, blood type, birthday and personality, then travel across five boards: kindergarten, elementary school, junior high, high school and adulthood. There are no dice - a random number sets how many steps you may take, but you choose your own route. Events with other characters spring up along the way, friendships form and romances can begin, and you can work toward careers ranging from public servant and athlete to artist and office worker. With friends or family, up to four players compete, and at the end everyone is judged on how fulfilling a life they led.

- 1 to 4 players, human or computer
- Multi-terminal 6 (multitap) compatible
- Memory backup save

好きな人と恋愛・結婚ができます。
なりたい職業になれます。新感覚のボードゲーム！！
